set.body:
Source: 2026-08-03 full-codebase review.

Problem:
P8.G2 introduced RemoteExchangeBudget to bound simultaneous SSH processes,
because ADR 0003 gives every request its own process and a batch awaits with
elements.parTraverse(_.await). In ssh/RemoteBatch.scala the script-batch element
handle routed only its exit read through budget.use; the accounting probe called
remote.accounting directly. RemoteTask.scala already budgeted the equivalent probe,
so the two paths disagreed.

The probe fires on the first poll of every element, so the escape is not marginal:
the new suite shows a budget of 2 admitting 16 simultaneous accounting exchanges.
At the 4,096-element scale G2 was written for, that is 4,096 concurrent SSH
processes against a shared login node -- the exact condition the budget exists to
prevent.

Acceptance:
- Route the script-batch accounting probe through budget.use.
- Test counts peak concurrent accounting exchanges at the SshProcessRunner seam,
  so it measures real processes rather than call sites, and was demonstrated RED.

Not addressed here: the batch log reads at RemoteBatch.scala:77 and :465 are also
unbudgeted. They are caller-driven rather than poll-driven, so they do not
multiply per tick, but they belong to the same ceiling.
set.title: P8.A8: Hold the script-batch accounting probe to the exchange budget
